department: Department of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences

deadline.value: The page still shows the Fall 2026 cycle (deadline January 15, 2026, references included); expect January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027. Files are reviewed as they complete, so apply early.
deadline.quote: The application deadline (including submission of references) is January 15 | Many of our successful applicants are admitted well before the listed deadlines.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required; you may upload scores if you have them.
gre_general.quote: Do I need to provide GRE (or similar) scores? | No. However, if you have taken the GRE test or similar, it does not hurt to upload the results.

gre_subject.value: No GRE (including the subject test) is required; scores may be uploaded.
gre_subject.quote: No. However, if you have taken the GRE test or similar, it does not hurt to upload the results.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 with at least 22 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum score of 100 (internet based), with a score of at least 22 in each individual skill area.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.0 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum score of 7.0 overall with a minimum of 6.0 on each band for admission.

english_waiver.value: Exempt only with a degree from a Canadian institution or from a country/school on the GPS exemption list (for India, listed institutions such as IITs and IISc).
english_waiver.quote: possession of a degree from a country or school listed on the Faculty of Graduate Studies Exemption List

supervisor.value: You need not name a supervisor; the department matches applicants, but contacting faculty may strengthen your application.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to specify a prospective supervisor? | No. We will try to match applications with prospective supervisors as best we can. However, contacting a faculty member beforehand and making them aware that you are interested in working with them may strengthen your application.

funding.value: U of A guarantees every PhD student at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4; the department's guarantee is at least CAD 29,481/yr plus about CAD 4,500/yr extra for international students.
funding.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

also.quote: International students are guaranteed to receive the same amounts and an additional approximate $4,500 per year to partially cover their increased tuition and program fees.

entry_route.value: PhD entry needs an MSc in Statistics or a closely related area; others are admitted to the MSc and may transfer.
entry_route.quote: Hold an MSc degree in Mathematics or Statistics (depending on the choice of PhD program), or a closely related area. | Students seeking a PhD degree who do not hold an MSc degree or equivalent will be admitted into the MSc program instead.
